coaching.headline: The offlane sank the game: TwinBlast fed on Scarlett from start to finish, and won fights never became towers.

flags.text: Shit lane: all five TwinBlast kills landed on Scarlett, and TwinBlast finished as the game's richest player.
Structures went six to one for the enemy; TwinBlast destroyed the allied offlane outer, offlane inhibitor and Core.
Four won fights, zero converted; despite a plus-five early kill lead, team gold finished 48.1k to 54.5k.
Revenant was the damn damage engine: 21089 hero damage, the most in the game, at 917 per minute.

focus.title: Fix the offlane, then take towers
focus.action: When TwinBlast wins the offlane early, Khaimera's next gank goes offlane and Scarlett holds under the tower until the gank lands; after any won fight, hit the nearest standing tower before resetting.

15.call: Lost 2-3 as the enemy took Fangtooth: Revenant, Dekker and Khaimera died ahead of the take, and Argus killed Murdock at the pit just after. With three allies dead, give up Fangtooth and hold the lanes.

10.3.call: Won 3-2 in separate plays, then TwinBlast took the allied offlane outer. Revenant's duo-lane double kill on Murdock and Renna was the moment to hit the enemy duo outer.

19.6.call: Lost 0-3 right after the allied duo outer fell: Renna killed Revenant and Dekker on the duo lane, Boris killed Khaimera on mid. With the duo outer gone, regroup with mid first.

22.4.call: Lost 0-3 in separate plays: Boris and Murdock killed Revenant and Dekker on the duo lane; TwinBlast killed Scarlett in the allied base, then destroyed the Core. With the inhibitor gone, defend as five.

a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Died four times on the offlane and once in the allied base. After a death to TwinBlast, skip the next trade until the next item lands.
Hero damage ran 77 per minute against a 546 norm, a game-low total. Once the enemy offlane outer falls, shove the wave and join the next duo-lane fight.
95b5ddfd-6e60-46c9-b36a-c5cefe662593: Kill participation hit 68%, with four kills, nine assists and no deaths before minute ten. When the duo lane gets ahead again, keep forcing fights beside Revenant.
Three of four deaths went to Murdock on the duo lane; Renna placed 12 wards to nine. When Murdock goes unseen, ward the duo-lane flank first.
acf08ff4-e8f1-46fa-a98d-5a9067c4b73a: Seven deaths on a 4.75 norm, two outside any detected fight to Murdock and Renna on the duo lane. Without vision on Murdock, trade only beside Dekker.
CS ran 3.8 per minute against a 5.4 norm, and only Vanquisher and Imperator finished. When the enemy duo backs, farm the duo wave before chasing the next kill.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: One death, the team's fewest, and two rotation kills on the duo lane, Boris early and Murdock late. When the duo lane fights, keep making the trip down from mid.
The lone death, to Howitzer on the duo lane, came seconds before the mid outer fell. Before leaving mid late, shove the mid wave first.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Game-high 16892 objective damage, with the team taking Fangtooth and two Mini Primes. After the next Mini Prime, call the team to siege the enemy duo outer.
Three of five deaths went to Boris, and 8784 gold was the game's lowest. Before the next gank, call the target and confirm a laner follows.

matchup: TwinBlast was the lane opponent at 5/1/2 with 18491 hero damage; Khaimera scored the only TwinBlast death.
After any ability cast, TwinBlast's Gunslinger passive fires the next basic attack three times.
TwinBlast's Tainted Rounds cuts the target's healing 45% for 3s on basic-attack hits, trimming Mutilator omnivamp and Marrow heals.
build: Mutilator, Terminus and Solaris replaced the whole 52.4% winning core of Alternator, Earthshaker and The Perforator.
Mutilator adds 1% max-health damage per basic attack, applied three times per ability hit on heroes, once per ability.
Three items and zero armor against a three-physical enemy comp.
eternal: Marrow heals for a share of hero damage, more at low health; Roses pays bonus gold on takedowns.
Field data clearly favors Knell for Scarlett offlane; Marrow sits second.
Under Marrow, Leech with Jealousy is the top pair; the Blood Bank and Roses run ranks second.
augment: Volcaic Slam makes empowered Cindara leave a rupture, erupting for damage and a 40% slow.
Volcaic Slam leans ahead of Coup De Grâce in the Scarlett offlane field. Sound keep.
crest: Liberator's Purifying Guard active cleanses debuffs and grants a short shield.
Gravitum and Iceskorn Talons tie for the Scarlett offlane crest lead; Liberator sits seventh among crests with enough games.
The two leaders evolve from Champion Crest; Liberator comes from Sharpshooter Crest.
improvement: If TwinBlast snowballs again, Citadel over Solaris adds armor scaling with nearby enemy heroes, giving up crit and Solarblade's heal.
Knell for Marrow follows the clear field edge, trading damage-based healing for Rust armor shred on hits.

matchup: Allied duo against Murdock and Renna: five enemy duo deaths before minute ten, three allied.
Murdock's Static Trap roots, and Buckshot shreds physical armor and pushes back.
Renna's Stupor mesmerizes, and Mortal Coil pulls targets in and executes at low health.
build: Crescelia and Timewarp are two of the 50.7% winning core; Tainted Scepter is missing, with Dynamo third.
Dynamo makes an immobilized enemy take 8% more damage for 2.5s; Stasis Bomb's stun can trigger the passive.
Dynamo was the only allied item carrying armor, into a three-physical enemy comp.
eternal: Weald's major launches true-damage missiles once a hero below 30% health takes damage; Barkskin hits back at basic attackers.
Lotus is clearly best in the Dekker support field; Weald ranks third of five with enough games.
Forage with Wind-Rider is the best Weald pair; swapping Barkskin for Wind-Rider matches the pair.
augment: Photon Efficiency adds 10% Photon Disruptor damage and cuts the cooldown 15% on hero hits.
Nothin' But Net and Polarity Strike tie for the Dekker support lead; Photon Efficiency, the most played, ranks third.
crest: Rift Walkers' active dashes and pulls nearby heroes; Visionary raises the ward cap from two to three.
Silentium and Reclamation tie for the Dekker support crest lead; Rift Walkers ranks sixth of seven with enough games.
Rift Walkers evolves from Warden Crest; the two leaders evolve from Keeper Crest.
improvement: Against Boris's game-high healing, Tainted Scepter over Dynamo cuts healing on magical hits, giving up the only allied armor.
Lotus over Weald follows the clear field edge: random stat gains over time and on takedowns, giving up the missiles.

matchup: Murdock was the lane opponent: three kills on Revenant, two deaths to Revenant.
Renna died eight times, the game's most, with Revenant scoring five of the eight.
Murdock's Long Arm of the Law ignores all physical armor and has unlimited range.
build: Vanquisher and Imperator are two of the 59.6% winning core; Terminus never finished.
Imperator makes critical strikes deal 30% more damage; Vanquisher executes heroes taken below 5% health.
eternal: Vermis adds max-health physical damage on every third consecutive basic attack; Serration adds missing-health damage.
Lotus leans ahead in the Revenant carry field; Vermis ranks last of nine Eternals with enough games.
Serration with Melting Point is the only Vermis pair with enough games, matching the run.
augment: Hellfire Blast makes the Fourth Shot deal 7% more damage and ignore 30% bonus physical armor.
Quickdraw leans ahead of Spectral Bounty in the Revenant carry field; Hellfire Blast, the most played, ranks third.
crest: Pacifier's Adrenalize dashes and empowers the next physical hit, stronger below 20% max health, recastable after a kill.
Liberator leans ahead of Pacifier in the Revenant carry field, on the same Sharpshooter Crest path.
improvement: Quickdraw over Hellfire Blast follows the field lean: faster reloads and higher jumps, giving up Fourth Shot armor ignore.
Terminus as the third item completes the winning core, though Murdock's Tainted Rounds trims healing on basic-attack hits.
Lotus over Vermis follows the field lean, trading third-hit max-health damage for random stat gains.

matchup: Howitzer was the lane opponent: 3/0/3, 10832 hero damage, and 10875 gold against 10559.
Howitzer's Land Mine knocks back and stuns; Make It Rain lifts Howitzer into the sky to rain missiles.
build: Azure Core and Wraith Leggings are two of the 54% winning core; Combustion sits where Entropy would.
Combustion's Pyro deals bonus damage to the target and nearby enemies on ability damage.
Wraith Leggings, finished last, adds 12% bonus magical ability damage on heroes below 40% health; earlier fights ran without the passive.
eternal: Vesh repeats a share of ability damage on heroes as damage over time; Mind Rot adds current-health damage.
Satariel leans first in the Argus midlane field; Vesh ranks third of five Eternals with enough games.
Lich with Mind Rot is the best Vesh pair, matching the run.
augment: Infinite Obliteration gives Synaptic Obliterator beams infinite range, 50% faster travel and 50% longer slows.
Infinite Obliteration, Arcane Engine and Mana Catalyst are a toss-up; Infinite Obliteration has the best odds. Sound keep.
crest: Soulbearer's Anima active grants a shield, 20% magical lifesteal and 10% movement speed.
Soulbearer leans first in the Argus midlane crest field and evolves from Wizard Crest. Sound keep.
improvement: Entropy over Combustion completes the winning core: extra damage per ability hit instead of Pyro's splash on nearby enemies.
Satariel over Vesh follows the field lean, trading damage over time for takedown power stacks lost on death.

matchup: Boris was the jungle opponent: three kills on Khaimera, one death to Khaimera.
Boris's 12808 healing led all ten players, and Rebirth resurrects Boris shortly after dying.
Boris's Ursine Burst grabs the first enemy hero hit and slams the target into the ground.
build: Overlord, Draconum and Rapture, the 52.8% winning core, never made the build.
Claw Of Hermes drains mana on basic attacks for true damage, and Mindflare adds ability damage against low-mana targets.
Manta Scythe deals 8% more damage to enemy units with no ally within 1000 units.
eternal: Lotus grants random stat gains over time and on takedowns; Masterpiece adds damage and speed on kills.
Lotus leans ahead of Satariel in the Khaimera jungle field. Sound keep.
Masterpiece with Immaculate is the best Lotus pair, matching the run.
augment: Jungle Invasion grants physical power in the jungle, doubled in the enemy jungle.
Jungle Invasion leans ahead of Lane Lurker in the Khaimera jungle field. Sound keep.
crest: Judgement's Thunder Cleaver active damages an area around the user and heals on hero hits.
Eviscerator is clearly the field's best Khaimera jungle crest; Judgement ranks sixth among crests with enough games.
Eviscerator evolves from Sharpshooter Crest, Judgement from Champion Crest.
improvement: Draconum over Claw Of Hermes adds armor against a three-physical comp plus a takedown heal, and belongs to the winning core.
Tainted Blade cuts healing 45% on physical damage, an answer to Boris's game-high healing.
Eviscerator over Judgement follows the clear field edge: attack speed, omnivamp and empowered hits instead of the area heal.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Howitzer Land Mine (knockback). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Stasis Bomb stun → Photon Disruptor slow → Containment Fence wall → Ion Strike slow ult
ourKits.winCondition: lock a target with stun + fence and let the team collapse
ourKits.passive: Rocket Boots mobility, refreshed by abilities
ourKits.playWith: burst that converts her stun/fence into a kill
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Stasis Bomb; the fence zones — flank around it

ourKits.combo: Scar mark → Obliterate homing missiles → Reckoning 1v1 realm ult
ourKits.winCondition: Reckoning a target into the Nether Realm and crit them down 1v1
ourKits.playWith: a team to clean up if his 1v1 stalls
ourKits.playAgainst: the ult is a 1v1 — peel the realmed ally can't help, so don't be caught alone; he's crit-reliant early-weak

ourKits.combo: Dread Nova stun → Ether Crystal push/lift → Particle Shredder channel → Synaptic Obliterator beams
ourKits.winCondition: poke from max range and zone with the crystal
ourKits.playWith: a frontline to protect his stationary channel
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Dread Nova; dive him during the immobile ult channel

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
ourKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
ourKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

enemyKits.combo: Slow Grenades / Land Mine zone → R2000 Missile → Make It Rain ult
enemyKits.winCondition: wall off space with mines/grenades and rain artillery on a held enemy
enemyKits.playWith: CC and chokes that force enemies into his zones
enemyKits.playAgainst: immobile turret — flank his mine zones, dive when ult is down

enemyKits.combo: Detection Protocol track → Chrono Swipe → Primeval Roar shield → Ursine Burst grab ult
enemyKits.winCondition: grab a key target out of position and burst them down
enemyKits.playWith: a team that collapses on his grabbed target
enemyKits.playAgainst: his grab ult is the whole threat — bait it / stay spaced; CC during Primeval Roar

enemyKits.combo: Vortex Grenade → Vaporize pierce → Rocket Dash reposition → Ventilate ult
enemyKits.winCondition: reposition with Rocket Dash and unload Ventilate from safety
enemyKits.passive: abilities grant AS + a triple-shot next basic
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline to create his free-fire window
enemyKits.playAgainst: he's mobile but squishy — CC through the dash, then burst

enemyKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe
enemyKits.winCondition: trap for the root, then out-range with Shots Fired and finish with the global ult
enemyKits.passive: every 5th basic is a long-range bonus shot
enemyKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
enemyKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

enemyKits.combo: Soulfire waves → Mortal Coil pull-zone → Stupor orb → Abyssal Rift zone
enemyKits.winCondition: zone a fight with Mortal Coil + ult and chunk from range
enemyKits.passive: consumes essences from kills for power
enemyKits.playWith: frontline to hold enemies in her zones
enemyKits.playAgainst: fragile and reliant on her zones — flank/dive around the telegraphs

ability.name: Static Trap
